claim: The one-click sample uses separate storage, can be reset, and does not change real routine data.
where: Home sample action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh browser; seed real routine, edit and reset demo, leave demo, assert real routine is unchanged.

claim: A routine can contain listening, reading, speaking, and recall blocks.
sandbox: Fresh demo; assert all four labeled block types and the sample duration.

claim: Routine blocks are editable.
sandbox: Fresh demo; edit a block title, reload, and assert the edited title remains.

claim: Routine blocks can be reordered without dragging.
sandbox: Fresh demo; move the second block earlier and assert order after reload.

claim: Optional source links stay local until the learner opens them.
where: Block editor, privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh demo with request capture; save a source, reload it, and assert no request reaches that source.

claim: The session screen provides a timer and ordered block checklist.
sandbox: Fresh demo; start and pause the timer, then complete one of four listed blocks.

claim: Complete sessions are recorded in local history.
sandbox: Fresh demo; complete all blocks and assert a third history row remains after reload.

claim: The next stage becomes available only after the configured number of complete sessions.
where: Home progression panel, rules page, README
sandbox: Fresh demo begins at two of three sessions; complete one routine and assert Stage 2.

claim: Changing the session threshold does not rewrite completion history.
sandbox: Fresh demo; change threshold and assert both existing history rows remain.

claim: The app does not automatically change content or difficulty.
where: Privacy and limits section, rules page, README
sandbox: Fresh demo; change only the threshold and assert every block title remains unchanged.

claim: The routine works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Separate fresh context; load demo once, wait for control, clear HTTP cache, go offline, reload, and assert the routine.

claim: The app provides an installable PWA shell.
sandbox: Fresh demo; inspect the fetched manifest and assert an active service worker.

claim: Routine data persists in IndexedDB across reloads.
sandbox: Fresh demo; change a duration, reload, and assert the changed total.

claim: Normal study use makes no model, analytics, tracking, or user-data requests to another origin.
sandbox: Fresh demo with full request capture; edit and export, then assert only same-origin GET requests.

claim: The free routine can be used without an account.
sandbox: Fresh demo; assert no credential inputs and begin the routine without authentication.

claim: Import reads a local file without uploading it.
where: Block editor, privacy section, privacy page
sandbox: Fresh demo with request capture; choose a local JSON file and assert only same-origin requests.

claim: JSON export includes the routine, rule, and complete history.
sandbox: Fresh demo; download and parse JSON, then assert four blocks, rule, and both history records.

claim: Import asks before replacing current data.
sandbox: Fresh demo; dismiss replacement once, then accept and assert the imported routine.

claim: Local deletion removes the routine and history.
sandbox: Enter through demo, start with an empty real namespace, create a routine, erase it, reload, and assert the empty state.

claim: The routine builder, timer, rules, offline use, and complete export remain free.
where: Home paid section, Plus page, terms, README
sandbox: Fresh demo without a license; assert session, rule, and export controls are enabled.

claim: Plus is priced at $12 once, and checkout is unavailable while product registration is pending.
sandbox: Fresh demo; open Plus and assert both exact price and current checkout status.

claim: Plus shows completed sessions from the last 90 days.
sandbox: Fresh demo; seed 18 recent rows and a cached valid license, then assert all 18 appear.

claim: Plus provides printable study sheets.
sandbox: Fresh demo with cached valid license; invoke the print control and assert window.print runs.

claim: A valid Plus license can be restored on another device.
sandbox: Fresh demo with recorded valid verification response; paste token and assert local active state.

claim: A refunded, revoked, or invalid license removes paid access.
sandbox: Fresh demo with recorded revoked response; start from cached paid state and assert print control is removed.

claim: The documented Node 22 build produces a served dist application.
sandbox: Playwright web server runs the production build; assert Node 22, HTTP 200, and the main landmark.
